design_fields.q2_rationale: The article does not specify whether student-level sampling/survey weights or replicate weights were applied, leaving it unclear if weights were used.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study does not analyze student-level survey data where schools are the sampling unit, as it focuses on process data.
design_fields.q4_rationale: There is no mention of any validation strategy, such as cross-validation or external validation, in the provided excerpts.
